steps.en: Officer changes the number of days for a stage on the settings page
steps.id: Officer mengubah jumlah hari tiap stage di halaman pengaturan

steps.en: The number of days can differ for each notice type
steps.id: Jumlah hari bisa berbeda untuk tiap jenis notice
steps.why_en: Settings are saved per stage only; one value applies to every notice type.
steps.why_id: Pengaturan disimpan per stage saja; satu nilai berlaku untuk semua jenis notice.

steps.en: The daily letter job sets the next date from the stage's days
steps.id: Job surat harian menghitung tanggal berikutnya dari jumlah hari stage
steps.why_en: The daily run is switched off in the program; it only runs when started by hand.
steps.why_id: Jalur harian dimatikan di program; hanya jalan kalau dijalankan manual.

steps.en: Notices entering the electronic notice stage use its configured days
steps.id: Notice yang masuk stage notice elektronik memakai jumlah hari yang diatur
